G1.evidence: Maryland does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 2614 published discipline decisions of the Attorney Grievance Commission of Maryland, 1976 to 2026. 2 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Maryland publishes no business register we can query. SDAT's entity search is a form rather than a dataset, its bulk data is sold rather than published, and the state's open data portal carries a count of businesses instead of the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.
